title: Single-User UX Polish
observations: TDD red phase (47 tests across 4 files) covered all 5 ACs exhaustively. Tests passed on first implementation run — zero test-driven rework.

Architecture plan reconciliation table verified all 5 targets before code: Sidebar (AppShell+Sidebar), SettingsOrgChart (internal conditional), KnowledgeCreateDialog (useTeams hook), SettingsNotifications (useHumanCount hook), reactivity (hook-based re-mount). Zero mid-stream discovery gaps.
Pattern reuse from BetCreateDialog (teams.length === 1 precedent, lines 59+138) reduced design risk. Existing conditional-hide pattern proved replicable across 4 surfaces.

Design critique scored 9/10 (UI consistency, contextual messaging). Architecture critique scored 9/10 (layer integrity, data flow). Code review verdict DONE with 2 non-blocking observations (settings/useHumanCount.ts shim file cost vs mock-path savings). Zero blocking findings.

Implementation-review handoff clean: critique findings about OrgChart threshold (=== 1 vs <= 1) were design-as-intent, not bugs. Builder correctly interpreted AC text and implemented the literal behavior.
Routine pipeline structure (no design variants, single-pattern scope) enabled straight-line execution: scaffolding → design+arch → critique → code → review → ship. 4 commits, no rework cycles.

Complexity estimates accurate: S rating, ~2h scope. Actual timeline: 6-day elapsed (including other concurrent AD workpackages), but productive phases compressed to <3h by automation and pattern reuse.
cost_signals: Zero rework cost (0%) — TDD red phase prevented all edge-case surprises.
Pattern reuse reduced architecture planning from S(1.5h) to S(1.0h). Existing BetCreateDialog precedent was authoritative.
Pipeline efficiency: 4 commits, 2 critiques, 1 code review, 0 rework = textbook routine execution for complexity=S.
what_went_well: TDD discipline: 47 tests written upfront, all pass first implementation (CC-010 pattern confirmed again)
Plan reconciliation table (section 2 in architecture) caught zero gaps; all assumptions verified before code (CC-010 pattern from AA1/AB3)
Critique→code handoff: design and architecture critiques identified 0 blockers, 2 non-blocking observations. Builder applied findings cleanly.
Pattern leverage: existing teams.length === 1 guard from BetCreateDialog (BetCreateDialog.tsx line 59) was directly reusable for Sidebar + AppShell (AC-1).
Routine classification prevented false complexity: only 1 design variant needed (no multi-variant exploration). Designer moved directly to implementation logic (design.md Phase 1).
friction_signals: settings/useHumanCount.ts re-export shim (10 lines) adds file overhead but saves mock path consistency in tests. Code review marked as 'non-blocking informational' — acceptable tradeoff for path isolation.
process_observations: Routine workpackages (complexity=S, single-pattern) execute as straight-line pipelines with no variant exploration. AD3 is archetype for this class: concept-design-arch (bundled), critique (2 phases), code review (1 cycle), ship. Estimated 2h actual ~<3h.

Design-it-twice present but minimal (useHumanCount hook: Option A simple fetch-wrap vs Option B prop threading). Decision clearly articulated with tradeoff rationale. Pattern matches X2, AB3 design-critique discipline.

Critique handoff intentional ambiguity on OrgChart threshold (=== 1 vs <= 1) resolved by builder reading AC text literally. Process: when critique findings reflect AC interpretation, code review catches it (did not happen here — builder read correctly). Recommend: explicit thresholds in ACs where boundary semantics matter.
